description: Funnel exploration (Data API v1alpha runFunnelReport): how many users reach each step and where they drop off. Steps are events (e.g. view_item → add_to_cart → begin_checkout → purchase), optionally with parameter or dimension conditions. Result rows per step: activeUsers, funnelStepCompletionRate, funnelStepAbandonments, funnelStepAbandonmentRate. Note: this Google API is in alpha.

breakdown_dimension.description: Split each step by a dimension, e.g. "deviceCategory" or "sessionDefaultChannelGroup".

date_ranges.description: Up to 4 date ranges. Default: last 28 full days (28daysAgo to yesterday). Several ranges add a "dateRange" column (e.g. for period comparisons).

name.description: Optional label; shows up as the "dateRange" column when you pass several ranges.

dimension_filter.description: Limit the funnel to users matching these dimension conditions (e.g. a country).

case_sensitive.description: String ops and in_list only. Default false.

field.description: Dimension or metric API name, e.g. "eventName", "pagePath", "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "sessions".

op.description: String ops: exact, contains, begins_with, ends_with, full_regex (RE2, whole value), partial_regex; in_list (uses "values"); numeric ops: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte (use a number "value"), between (uses "from"/"to"); empty (value is empty / not set).

value.description: Value to compare with (string ops and numeric ops).

any.description: At least one of these conditions must match (OR).

case_sensitive.description: String ops and in_list only. Default false.

field.description: Dimension or metric API name, e.g. "eventName", "pagePath", "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "sessions".

op.description: String ops: exact, contains, begins_with, ends_with, full_regex (RE2, whole value), partial_regex; in_list (uses "values"); numeric ops: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte (use a number "value"), between (uses "from"/"to"); empty (value is empty / not set).

value.description: Value to compare with (string ops and numeric ops).

limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 100. The result says when more rows exist (next_offset).

next_action_dimension.description: Show what users did next after each step: "eventName", "pagePath", "pageTitle", "unifiedScreenName" (and a few more).

open_funnel.description: Open funnel: users can enter at any step. Default false (closed: everyone starts at step 1).

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

return_property_quota.description: Include the property quota status in the result.

steps.description: Funnel steps in order (2–10). Each needs event_name and/or conditions.

conditions.description: Conditions on dimensions (all must match), e.g. [{"field": "pagePath", "op": "begins_with", "value": "/checkout"}]. Op "empty" is not supported.

case_sensitive.description: String ops and in_list only. Default false.

field.description: Dimension or metric API name, e.g. "eventName", "pagePath", "sessionDefaultChannelGroup", "sessions".

op.description: String ops: exact, contains, begins_with, ends_with, full_regex (RE2, whole value), partial_regex; in_list (uses "values"); numeric ops: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte (use a number "value"), between (uses "from"/"to"); empty (value is empty / not set).

value.description: Value to compare with (string ops and numeric ops).

directly_followed_by.description: The next step must happen directly after this one (no events in between). Default false.

event_name.description: Event that completes this step, e.g. "view_item", "add_to_cart", "begin_checkout", "purchase".

event_params.description: Extra conditions on that event's parameters (all must match). Needs event_name.

item_param.description: Match an item-level parameter (e.g. "item_category") instead of an event parameter.

param.description: Event parameter name, e.g. "payment_type", or an item parameter with item_param: true.

name.description: Step label shown in the result, e.g. "1. View item".

within_seconds.description: This step must happen within N seconds of the previous step.

trended.description: Also return a day-by-day (trended) funnel. Default false.

name: run_funnel_report
title: Run a GA4 funnel report
